answer: Farming becomes a vertex bet on surviving 55 epochs of grading, and every violet settlement recomputes the copper schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 55 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
